text:
A scientist fires alpha-particles at a very thin sheet of gold and detects the particles that pass
through.
Which statement about the results of the scattering experiment is correct?
A
Alpha-particles are attracted to the nucleus of the atoms in the metal sheet.
B
Half the mass of the atom is concentrated in the nucleus.
C
Most of the alpha-particles are deflected, showing that the nucleus is very dense.
D
Only a small number of alpha-particles are deflected, but some of these are deflected
through large angles.

options.label: A
options.text: Alpha-particles are attracted to the nucleus of the atoms in the metal sheet.

options.label: B
options.text: Half the mass of the atom is concentrated in the nucleus.

options.label: C
options.text: Most of the alpha-particles are deflected, showing that the nucleus is very dense.
